# runzero_asset (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero asset by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the asset.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (List of String) IP addresses associated with the asset.
- `addresses_extra` (List of String) Additional addresses associated with the asset.
- `agent_name` (String) The agent name.
- `alive` (Boolean) Whether the asset is alive.
- `attributes` (Map of String) Attributes associated with the asset.
- `comments` (String) Comments on the asset.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was created.
- `credentials` (Map of String) Credentials associated with the asset.
- `criticality` (String) The criticality level of the asset.
- `detected_by` (String) How the asset was detected.
- `domains` (List of String) Domains associated with the asset.
- `eol_os` (Number) End-of-life date for the operating system.
- `eol_os_ext` (Number) Extended end-of-life date for the operating system.
- `finding_count` (Number) Number of findings.
- `first_seen` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was first seen.
- `hw` (String) The hardware description of the asset.
- `last_agent_id` (String) UUID of the last agent that scanned the asset.
- `last_seen` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was last seen.
- `last_task_id` (String) UUID of the last task that scanned the asset.
- `lowest_rtt` (Number) Lowest round-trip time observed.
- `lowest_ttl` (Number) Lowest TTL observed.
- `mac_vendors` (List of String) MAC address vendors.
- `macs` (List of String) MAC addresses associated with the asset.
- `names` (List of String) Hostnames associated with the asset.
- `newest_mac` (String) Most recently observed MAC address.
- `newest_mac_age` (Number) Age of the most recently observed MAC address.
- `newest_mac_vendor` (String) Vendor of the most recently observed MAC address.
- `org_name` (String) The organization name.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization UUID.
- `os` (String) The operating system of the asset.
- `os_version` (String) The OS version of the asset.
- `risk` (String) The risk level of the asset.
- `risk_rank` (Number) The numeric risk rank.
- `scanned` (Boolean) Whether the asset has been scanned.
- `service_count` (Number) Total number of services on the asset.
- `service_count_arp` (Number) Number of ARP services.
- `service_count_icmp` (Number) Number of ICMP services.
- `service_count_tcp` (Number) Number of TCP services.
- `service_count_udp` (Number) Number of UDP services.
- `service_ports_tcp` (List of String) TCP service ports.
- `service_ports_udp` (List of String) UDP service ports.
- `service_products` (List of String) Service products detected.
- `service_protocols` (List of String) Service protocols detected.
- `site_id` (String) The site ID the asset belongs to.
- `site_name` (String) The site name.
- `sources` (List of String) Data sources for the asset.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags associated with the asset.
- `type` (String) The type of the asset.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the asset was last updated.
- `vulnerability_count` (Number) Number of vulnerabilities found.
